wardley map, draft, made 2026-11-23T22:09Z by cartographer.d@AgentiCCells.dinis from 2 sources (see the JSON)

circle.title: Odoo (source: landscape) Odoo. Odoo 19 docs show an External JSON-2 API with API keys (manual or programmatic generation) and access rights; plan availability not read (page truncated). Price: not read. https://www.odoo.com/documentation/19.0/developer/reference/external_api.html (read 2026-11-23)

OpenRouter (source: landscape) OpenRouter. Terms bar reselling API access or building a competing service; third-party tools fall under their own terms (10.3). Price: not read. https://openrouter.ai/terms (read 2026-11-23)

AWS (source: landscape) AWS. AWS legal page links the Customer Agreement, Acceptable Use Policy and Trademark Guidelines; contents not read. Price: not read. https://aws.amazon.com/legal/ (read 2026-11-23)

Wikipedia (source: landscape) Wikipedia. Text reusable under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; credit by link to the article or history, or an author list. Price: not read. https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use (read 2026-11-23)

OWASP Cheat Sheet Seri... (source: landscape) OWASP Cheat Sheet Series. Licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0; OWASP says its Markdown files are not meant to be cited externally, use the official site. Price: not read. https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries (read 2026-11-23)

OWASP (source: landscape) OWASP. OWASP and Open Worldwide Application Security Project are registered trademarks of the OWASP Foundation. Price: not read. https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries (read 2026-11-23)

OWASP Top Ten (source: landscape) OWASP Top Ten. Top Ten project page states no licence, only an all-rights-reserved footer; the policy licensing page returned 404. Price: not read. https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/ (read 2026-11-23)

mcp-server-odoo (ivnvx... (source: landscape) mcp-server-odoo (ivnvxd). MCP server letting AI assistants search, read, create, update and delete Odoo records, with opt-in workflow calls. Price: not read. https://github.com/ivnvxd/mcp-server-odoo (read 2026-11-23)

Odoo MCP (tuanle96 / E... (source: landscape) Odoo MCP (tuanle96 / ERPipe author). Python MCP server with 41 tools for reading and aggregating Odoo data, with a gated write workflow; billed as a free AI layer for any Odoo 16+. Price: not read. https://github.com/tuanle96/mcp-odoo (read 2026-11-23)

MCP Server module (muc... (source: landscape) MCP Server module (much. Consulting). Odoo 19 module adding a /mcp endpoint so Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Cursor can work with Odoo records, with 17 built-in tools. Price: not read. https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/mcp_server (read 2026-11-23)

Not found: Odoo AI product page (source: landscape) Odoo AI product page. Odoo's own page at odoo.com/app/ai returned 404, so Odoo's own AI offer is not confirmed here. Price: not read. https://www.odoo.com/app/ai (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

RouterChat (aurokin) (source: landscape) RouterChat (aurokin). Open-source chat web app for OpenRouter models with model picker, thinking mode, web search and system prompts. Price: not read. https://github.com/aurokin/routerchat (read 2026-11-23)

L0 Chat (source: landscape) L0 Chat. Lightweight chat client for OpenRouter, reported by search to support web search and browser-stored key; the repository page itself returned 404 on fetch. Price: not read. https://github.com/dosvic/l0-chat (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Oriveo (source: landscape) Oriveo. Multi-model chat app (iOS, Android, web) that shows an estimated cost per reply, per OpenRouter's awesome list; own page not read. Price: not read. https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/awesome-openrouter (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Laminar, Helicone (two) (source: landscape) Laminar and Helicone. Listed on OpenRouter's awesome list as tracing and observability tools covering tokens, cost and latency of OpenRouter calls; own pages not read. Price: not read. https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/awesome-openrouter (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

all-api-hub (source: landscape) all-api-hub. Listed as a browser extension for browsing models and pricing; own page not read. Price: not read. https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/awesome-openrouter (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

OpenRouter own tools (source: landscape) OpenRouter own tools. OpenRouter's own chat page is a playground that compares several models side by side. Price: not read. https://openrouter.ai/chat (read 2026-11-23)

Brows3 (source: landscape) Brows3. Desktop client for browsing and managing objects in S3 and S3-compatible storage, with search, editor, preview and sync. Price: not read. https://github.com/rgcsekaraa/brows3 (read 2026-11-23)

Filestash (source: landscape) Filestash. Web file manager for S3 and compatible buckets: browse, upload, edit documents, shared links without exposing keys. Price: not read. https://filestash.app/s3-browser.html (read 2026-11-23)

S3UI (source: landscape) S3UI. Search listing says desktop dual-pane S3 manager with cost tracking; the PyPI page was not read in detail. Price: not read. https://pypi.org/project/s3ui/ (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

OpenCost (source: landscape) OpenCost. Cost visibility for Kubernetes and cloud spend (AWS, Azure, GCP), broken down by cluster, namespace or pod. Price: not read. https://github.com/opencost/opencost (read 2026-11-23)

Komiser (source: landscape) Komiser. Cloud resource manager for cost, usage, security and idle-resource detection across AWS and other clouds. Price: not read. https://github.com/tailwarden/komiser (read 2026-11-23)

AWS Billing and Cost M... (source: landscape) AWS Billing and Cost Management MCP server (awslabs). AWS's own MCP server giving AI assistants Cost Explorer, Budgets, anomaly, Savings Plans and Compute Optimizer data. Price: not read. https://awslabs.github.io/mcp/servers/billing-cost-management-mcp-server (read 2026-11-23)
Wike (source: landscape) Wike. GNOME desktop Wikipedia reader with tabs, 300+ languages, bookmarks and themes. Price: not read. https://github.com/hugolabe/Wike (read 2026-11-23)
Kiwix Android (source: landscape) Kiwix Android. Offline reader making Wikipedia available from ZIM archives. Price: not read. https://github.com/kiwix/kiwix-android (read 2026-11-23)

wikipedia-mcp (Rudra-r... (source: landscape) wikipedia-mcp (Rudra-ravi). MCP server giving LLMs search, article text, summaries, sections and links from Wikipedia. Price: not read. https://github.com/Rudra-ravi/wikipedia-mcp (read 2026-11-23)

Wikipedia Android app ... (source: landscape) Wikipedia Android app (Wikimedia). Official Wikipedia Android app source, on Google Play. Price: not read. https://github.com/wikimedia/apps-android-wikipedia (read 2026-11-23)

Wikiwand (source: landscape) Wikiwand. Alternative reader listed by AlternativeTo as freemium proprietary; its own about page returned 403. Price: not read. https://www.wikiwand.com/en/about (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Wikiless (source: landscape) Wikiless. Privacy front-end seen in search; its repository URL returned 404. Price: not read. https://github.com/Metastem/Wikiless (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Price: not read. https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/integrations/owasp (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

svg.text: Green: user need. Purple: the shared goal. Blue: component. Red ring: a gap (named as missing in the sources). Orange arrow: a suggested move, for strategy.d. Faint dashed: low confidence. Positions are a reading of the sources.
